entities.name: Evelio Menjivar-Ayala
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Evelio Menjivar-Ayala is a Salvadoran-born priest of the Catholic Church who serves as auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Washington in the District of Columbia and Southern Maryland. He is the first Central American to serve as bishop in the United States.
